Optional licensed music file

If you have the necessary rights to use a recording of “Heartbeats” by José González on this website, place your licensed MP3 in this folder named heartbeats.mp3. The website will try to play /music/heartbeats.mp3 when the visitor opens the invitation. If the file is absent or playback fails, the original generated ambient soundtrack will play instead. Do not upload or distribute a copyrighted recording without permission.
